limitations: Exact group symmetry N=2a+1, M=a+1, linear feedback u=1 and 0<r*=4^a c/[b binom(2a,a)]<1 are essential.
Periodic trajectories are neutrally stable; arbitrary parameter perturbations, basin geometry and boundary dynamics are not classified.
Variance coefficient is sharp only asymptotically along small cycles and is strict for each nonconstant finite-amplitude cycle.
Publication priority is not independently confirmed; more general unexamined eco-evolutionary integrability results may exist.
title: An integrable neutral-cycle family with sharp average-risk amplification in symmetric collective-risk games
